_meta.principle: Data is SEPARATED from code: every parameter is adjustable here without reprogramming.
_meta.design_limits: Installed limits (installed_power_kW, installed_area_m2, max_capacity_tph, installed_burner_kW, installed_drum_volume_m3, max_airflow_m3h): null = to be provided from vendor/design data; the design check reports it as NO LIMIT until filled

CR.5003._note: Upstream of the pivot feed point (spec ch.5: the feed curve is MEASURED downstream of the primary station), so this machine is not wired into the flowsheet. Its parameters are used by the reference-curve calibration script only.

s_CSS.name: Closed-side setting (CSS) - informative only, not used by any computation

I.name: Imperfection (remapped I_new = 1 - I_old after the M3 arbitration: the spec-sheet 0.6 was written under the old inverted semantics; to confirm by a screen-product sieve test; range kept [0.1;0.9] deliberately (strict remap of the sheet range is [0.1;0.6], the wide max keeps rain-grade values reachable))
I.status: [H] Client arbitration 2026-08-10 (question 1/12): I = 0.15 adopted from literature (industrial dry vibrating screens I~0.10-0.15; Karra 1979 fixed exponent ~ classic imperfection 0.13). Supersedes the 0.4 inherited from the spec remap; to be re-fitted when a KFS product sieve test exists.

x80.name: Product x80 (null = follows gap; x80 = g validated 2026-08-08)

CR.5009._settings_note: g = 60 mm adopted 2026-08-13 (0/20-balance optimization campaign: coarser roll product preserves the 20-35 KFS band; was 40)

CR.5011._capacity_note: Q8 CLOSED 2026-08-11 (expert book ch.4, machine documents Ochse 2026-07-17): HAZEMAG AP-S 1010 — 100 t/h nominal, 75-90 t/h real on limestone (max_capacity_tph = 90, conservative bound 75), rotor 1000x1000, max feed 400 mm, motor 132 kW; capacity bound by the rotor, not the motor. Supersedes the spec's '~125 t/h (mode A)'. Operational constraint: in mode 1B the LINE feed must drop to ~130 t/h to keep the impactor in range (the engine does not enforce line feed; check mode-1B scenarios against this)
CR.5011._settings_note: CSS 30 mm / v 35 m/s adopted 2026-08-13 (same campaign: recycle re-crushed coarse reports to KFS; low speed limits fines). Mode 1B at 250 t/h is NOT possible at these settings (impactor would exceed capacity) — irrelevant since the 0/20 balance no longer needs stock campaigns

SR.5105.type: Reclaim screen 6 mm, single deck (PFD REV18; the spec's 15/5 double deck is SUPERSEDED — decision 2026-08-12)

a.name: Aperture (FeedLime cut: oversize a/20 = FeedLime, undersize 0/a -> AgLime loop)

SR.5111.type: First 1.7 mm closing screen, OPEN circuit (PFD REV18: undersize = AgLime, oversize -> CR.5113)
SR.5111._loop_rating_note: BC.5110/BC.5116 conveyors rated 60 T/h (PFD REV18) — alert when the loop feed exceeds it

I.name: Imperfection (same semantics and arbitration as SR.5115)

CR.5113.type: Impact crusher, AgLime loop (PFD REV18 tag; was CR.5107 in the spec — renamed 2026-08-12)

SR.5115.type: Second 1.7 mm closing screen, CLOSED loop with CR.5113 (PFD REV18: undersize joins AgLime, oversize recycles to the crusher)

I.name: Imperfection (remapped I_new = 1 - I_old after the M3 arbitration: the spec-sheet 0.6 was written under the old inverted semantics; to confirm by a screen-product sieve test; range kept [0.1;0.9] deliberately (strict remap of the sheet range is [0.1;0.6], the wide max keeps rain-grade values reachable))

Supersedes the 0.4 inherited from the spec remap; to be re-fitted when a KFS product sieve test exists.

DY.03._capacity_note: Client 2026-08-13: dryer capacity limit = 30 t/h AT THE OUTLET (dried product, 0.5 % moisture) = 32.1 t/h wet feed at 7 % (30 x 0.995 / 0.93). The engine cap max_capacity_tph checks the wet FEED.

S_att.name: Attrition per pass [H] (refitted after the M3 arbitration + imperfection remap; spec sheet default was 0.206)

ML.26._product_curve_note: Vendor abaque slot (golden rule 2): set to {"curve_pct": {mesh_mm: cumulative %}, "interpolation": "linear"|"log"} to replace hypotheses H-M7-1/2 with the vendor product curve
ML.26._model_note: Model M7 structure VALIDATED by literature (Thiere, TU Freiberg PhD 2020, pilot toothed double-roll tests): two-component product (gap-driven compression PSD + fines sub-collective), sub-gap bypass, reduction ratio ~4. The S_att constant could be refined to the published gap/feed-dependent form S_att = s0*(F80/g); a vendor product_curve_table remains the best upgrade

coupe.name: Cut size (Q6 CLOSED 2026-08-11: d50c = 0.65 x d97 = 65 um per expert book ch.11, Stokes equilibrium; was 100)

eta_cl.name: Extraction efficiency [H] (literature: real quarry air classifiers recover 50-65% at finer cuts; 0.75 is a defensible design midpoint for an easy ~100 um cut, flagged optimistic)

RC.1.type: Smooth double-roll crusher, stage 1 (C1 study variant — replaces ML.26; NOT adopted, as-built remains the default)

comp_lam.name: Compression [H] (smooth rolls: single-pass nip, low over-grinding vs toothed 4.11)

n_comp.name: RR slope n of the compression component [H] (smooth-roll product steepness; vendor gradation test pending)

S_att.name: Attrition per pass [H] (smooth rolls: no tooth attrition, surface abrasion only)

RC.1._product_curve_note: Vendor abaque slot (golden rule 2): a smooth-roll gradation test on WANKOE 6/20 fixes n_comp and S_att before any purchase.
RC.1._model_note: Model M7 with per-machine overrides (comp_lam, S_att, m7_n_comp). C1 design basis: docs/design/zone13-redesign/design-basis.md + panel-candidates.md (panel round 1, client-validated 2026-08-14).

RC.2.type: Smooth double-roll crusher, stage 2, SINGLE unit (client base scenario 2026-08-14: max grits capacity 69 300 t/y at the 22 t/h loop limit, dryer throttled to 22.3 t/h wet; a 2nd parallel unit is the EXTENSION provision for full-dryer regrind / 80 kt+)

n_comp.name: RR slope n of the compression component [H]

RC.2._product_curve_note: Vendor abaque slot (golden rule 2): roll capacity at 3.4 mm gap to be confirmed by vendor trial.
RC.2._model_note: max_capacity_tph is PER UNIT; the flowsheet splits the stage-2 feed across the units in service.
RC.2._extension_note: Client arbitration 2026-08-14: ONE unit installed (base scenario). Extension provision: civil works and layout must reserve the slot for a 2nd identical unit — with it, full-dryer regrind gives 16.66 t/h grits (100 kt/y at 6000 h). Alternative phase-1 stopgap: sliver diverter on 'extract' allows full dryer flow on one unit (14.6 t/h grits, 98.5 % unit load, 4 t/h sliver product to dispose).

SC.A.type: Double-deck RECYCLE screen 8 / 3.75 mm (C1 study variant, client arbitration 2026-08-14: 2+2 arrangement — recycle cuts on SC.A, product cuts on SC.B)

SC.B.type: Double-deck PRODUCT screen 2 / 1.5 mm (C1 study variant: deck 1 = grits bottom cut, D6-critical; deck 2 = fines top cut; both critical decks in favorable position — the 2+2 rationale)

a1.name: Aperture 1 (grits bottom cut; 2.0 protects the D6 <2 mm <= 15 %)

a2.name: Aperture 2 (fines top cut; 1.5 protects the 0/1.5 fines spec + redirect eligibility)

SC.B._routing_note: Client arbitration 2026-08-14: the 1.5/2 sliver (SC.B deck-2 oversize) is REGROUND through RC.2 ('regrind'); 'extract' keeps it as a separate Sliver 1.5/2 product. Two-position diverter in the plant design — reversible in operation; to be confirmed by the vendor gradation test (D6 margin 1.4 pts under regrind).

Wi.name: Bond work index
Wi.status: Q2 CLOSED 2026-08-11 [ref.]: 12.54 kWh/t confirmed by expert book ch.13 — Fontaine value (Belgian limestone), consistent with measured limestone range 12.6-13.9 kWh/t (Todorovic 2017). The kWh/short-ton hypothesis (13.8) is REJECTED; the spec ch.9 ~116 kW remains a spec-side artefact. Site Bond test still listed as a calibration trigger (book ch.13)

b_j.name: JKMRC parameter b
b_j.status: [H] literature default. FLAG (2026-08-08): A*b=48 is mid-hard; JKTech database trends put SOFT limestone at A*b~60-80 (b~1.0-1.4 at A=60) - current 0.8 is a conservative hard-side choice

I_dry.name: Screen imperfection (dry)
I_dry.status: [H] Client arbitration 2026-08-10 (question 1/12): I = 0.15 adopted from literature (industrial dry vibrating screens I~0.10-0.15; Karra 1979 fixed exponent ~ classic imperfection 0.13). Supersedes the 0.4 inherited from the spec remap; to be re-fitted when a KFS product sieve test exists.

b_cyclone.name: CL.38 cyclone inlet width
b_cyclone.status: design assumption adopted 2026-08-11 from expert book ch.12: D = 0.7 m, b = 0.2D = 0.14 m (Stairmand high-efficiency), Ne = 5, v_in = 15 m/s -> d50 = 4.2 um; sub-4 um tail leaves with the cleaned air and needs a polishing bag filter (equipment NOT in the flowsheet). Vendor drawing still to confirm

bottom_interval_ratio.name: Bottom size interval lower-bound ratio (rep. size = mesh/sqrt(ratio))

wet_capacity_factor.name: Screen basic-capacity derating factor under rain (outdoor screens)

engine._comment: Numerical engine settings - adjustable without reprogramming.

feed_product.comment: Pivot feed: belt-cut PSD MEASURED at the primary crusher outlet on 2026-08-08 (raw data: data/feed_measurements/2026-08-08-belt-cut.json). Measured range 19-200 mm; fine tail < 19 mm and top size completed by hypotheses H-FEED-1/H-FEED-2 (see data/measured_feed_curve.json, rebuild with scripts/build_feed_curve_from_measurement.py). envelope._note: KFS 30/55/15 envelope - three %-passing control thresholds (interpretation validated 2026-08-08). The spec's '15%' is the above-cut limit: a strict 15% total out-of-cut tolerance would always fail (Karra screening leaves ~43% out of 20/35), so max_out_of_cut_tol_pct is null (superseded by the envelope).

AgLime._criterion_note: Client decision 2026-08-12 (zone-1.2 doc question Q8): acceptance criterion >= 95 % passing 1.7 mm, i.e. max 5 % out of cut. No contractual AgLime spec existed before; this is the project criterion

FeedLime grits._envelope_note: D6 grits spec (client, zone-1.3 design basis 2026-08-14): <2 mm <= 15 %, >4 mm <= 5 %

Sliver 1.5/2._note: C1 study variant only, and only when SC.B oversize_routing = 'extract'. Client arbitration 2026-08-14: default routing is REGRIND (sliver returns to RC.2), so this product is normally absent.

stockpile_capacities_t._note: Yard capacities from the NACO/Carmeuse PFDs (2026-08-12) — data only, engine does not enforce them yet; flagged for the seasonal-swing check (zone-1.2 planning found ~16.4 kt FeedLime swing vs 6 kt capacity)

FeedLime grits 2-4._note: Client 2026-08-13 (evening): back to the FIRM 40 000 t/y — the 44 400 optimization variant remains available as a scenario, not the default

1.1._note: 1 shift, 6d/7 — Saturday extension decided by the client 2026-08-13 (Q7 securing lever; was 2000 h at 5d/7)

default_scenario._variant_note: 'as-built' = SN.21 + ML.26 closed loop (the default until the client adopts a redesign); 'c1' = 2-stage smooth rolls RC.1/RC.2 + SC.A triple deck + SC.B sliver screen (STUDY variant, panel round 1)
default_scenario._c1_base_feed_note: C1 base scenario (client 2026-08-14): zone_1_3_feedlime = 22.27 t/h wet (dryer at 69 %) so the single RC.2 unit runs at its 22 t/h loop capacity under regrind routing. The default 32.1 belongs to the as-built variant; set 22.27 when running c1 until C1 is formally adopted.

commercial_rules._note: Client rules governing how the planning closes the commercial balance
commercial_rules._020_note: Client 2026-08-13 (final): there is NO market for crude 0/20 — the excess beyond the downstream reclaim goes to LANDFILL and is a NET FINANCIAL LOSS. It must be reported as a loss (with an alert), never as a sale, and minimized by design/operating choices.
